title: AGENTS.md bans X-commands that code already implements
description: AGENTS.md line 61 says 'nothing that exposes CIDs or IPFS internals to clients' is permitted, but XCID, XVERIFY, and XGET are implemented and intentional (ADR-0007). The prohibition in AGENTS.md contradicts the implemented code without distinguishing 'prohibited' (topology/DHT/pin state) from 'permitted' (X-Stoa-* headers and X-prefixed CID commands). A contributor would not know whether to extend the X-command set or revert it. Update AGENTS.md to reflect the ADR-0007 distinction: CID/integrity X-commands are permitted if advertised in CAPABILITIES; topology/infrastructure exposure is prohibited.
